name: visit-pass
description: Plan a Jamaica visit in ChatGPT, then continue with Visit Pass's local concierge on WhatsApp.

interface.longDescription:
Visit Pass turns a trip plan into a local concierge. Tell ChatGPT where you're staying, when, who's coming and what you enjoy, and Visit Pass builds a day-by-day plan from curated Jamaica experiences: open on your dates, suited to your party, with half-day outings near where you stay, plus restaurant picks for your dietary needs.

When you're ready, Visit Pass gives you a personal visit code. Send it on WhatsApp and the Visit Pass concierge picks up where ChatGPT left off, with your trip already in hand: things to do, restaurants and visitor information, answered from Visit Pass's Jamaica information.

You start the WhatsApp chat yourself; Visit Pass never messages you first. A code works for one WhatsApp number, your trip details hold no contact or payment information, and they are cleared three days after you leave. Reply STOP at any time.
capabilities: Plan a day-by-day Jamaica itinerary from curated Jamaica experiences
Suggest restaurants for your dietary needs
Hand your trip to the Visit Pass concierge on WhatsApp with a personal visit code
Check whether your WhatsApp welcome is ready
Tell you how to reach Visit Pass directly
defaultPrompt: Plan 4 days in Jamaica for two, staying in Montego Bay
Where should we eat in Negril? One of us is vegetarian
Connect me with Visit Pass on WhatsApp

positive.description: Plans a multi-day itinerary from the bureau's own experiences
positive.prompt: Plan a 4-day trip to Jamaica for two adults staying in Montego Bay from 10 to 14 March. We love beaches, snorkelling and local food.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls plan_visit with the dates, party, base and interests, and shows a day-by-day plan card built from Visit Pass's experiences, with restaurant picks and an offer to continue on WhatsApp.

positive.prompt: We're staying in Negril next week and one of us is vegetarian. Where should we eat?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls plan_visit with the vegetarian requirement and returns Visit Pass restaurant picks suited to it, near Negril.

positive.description: Hands the trip to the WhatsApp concierge
positive.prompt: Plan a weekend in Ocho Rios for a family of four with two kids, then connect me with Visit Pass on WhatsApp.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls plan_visit, then start_visit, and returns a personal visit code with a WhatsApp link the traveller taps to send the code themselves. Nothing is sent to the traveller.

positive.description: Reports the state of the WhatsApp welcome
positive.prompt: I just got my visit code. Is my WhatsApp welcome from Visit Pass ready yet?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_visit_status with the code from the conversation and says whether the code has been sent on WhatsApp and whether the welcome cards are ready.

positive.description: Points to the bureau for questions the plan does not cover
positive.prompt: Does Visit Pass know the exact opening hours of Rick's Café on Christmas Day? Who can I ask?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_contact, says Visit Pass's information does not cover it, and gives the bureau's email, WhatsApp and website without inventing hours.

negative.prompt: Plan a 3-day trip to Paris for me.

negative.description: Flight booking is out of scope
negative.prompt: Book me a flight from New York to Kingston next Friday.
Write a short poem about the ocean.

publication.release_notes: A more visual plan card: each pick in the day-by-day plan, the extra ideas and the restaurant picks now show a photo, with the time of day, the area and the bureau's tip, and a clearer section on continuing with the concierge on WhatsApp. Tools and data handling are unchanged.
